messages.content:
You are the referee of a simulated phone call between a CALLER and a customer-service AGENT.
For each numbered condition, decide whether it is met RIGHT NOW, judging mainly the agent's LATEST turn in light of the whole call.
- "the agent first ..." / "the first time ..." means it happens in the latest turn and had not happened before.
- Conditions about what the agent says are judged on its words. "[system actions: ...]" lists tools the agent used; use them only for conditions about what the agent does (e.g. "starts looking up").
- Conditions phrased as a caller stop rule (e.g. "Agent confirms ...", "End the call right after ...") are met when the call has reached that point.
- Be literal and strict: if in doubt, it is not met.
Reply with JSON only, one key per condition id: {"<id>": {"met": true|false, "why": "<at most 15 words>"}}

CALL SO FAR:
CALLER: Hi honey, Tess Morgan, I need my water pill refilled. The furosemide.
AGENT: Hi Tess! I'd be happy to help you refill your furosemide. Let me just verify your information first—what's your date of birth?
CALLER: Sure thing, honey. January 19th, 1974.
AGENT: Thank you! Let me pull up your prescriptions. Great, Tess! Now let me look up your furosemide prescription. Perfect! I found your furosemide 40 mg, and you have 2 refills left. Let me queue that up for you at your home store, H-701. All set! Your furosemide will be ready tomorrow morning at ten o'clock at store H-701. Is there anything else I can help you with?  [system actions: verify_identity, list_prescriptions, queue_refill]
CALLER: That water pill has me running to the bathroom all morning, but that's normal, right? Oh, and can I pick it up after four instead? Mornings don't work for me.
AGENT: That's a question for your prescriber or our pharmacist about what you're experiencing—I can't advise on that. But I can have a pharmacist call you back if you'd like to discuss it.

As for pickup time, the refill is queued for tomorrow morning at ten. You're welcome to pick it up anytime after it's ready, so you can come by after four if that works better for you—it'll be waiting for you.
CALLER: It's always like that, honey. After four works great, thanks.
AGENT (LATEST): Perfect! You're all set to pick up after four tomorrow. Have a great day, Tess!

CONDITIONS:
move_2: the agent raises concern a second time
stop_0: Agent has queued the furosemide refill and given a ready time she understood.
emergency: In its LATEST turn, the agent told the caller to hang up and call 911 (or emergency services) now.

JSON only.

message.content: {"move_2": {"met": false, "why": "No repeated concern raised in latest turn"}, "stop_0": {"met": true, "why": "Refill queued and ready time given earlier"}, "emergency": {"met": false, "why": "No mention of 911 or emergency"}}
